sections.h2: Launch a brand, or host several

blocks.text: A defined launch package for a new brand. Real-time charging and settlement for the enabler that hosts several.

A new brand needs a working BSS before it has customers, while the enabler that hosts several brands needs to keep them apart and settle with each one. Alepo's **MVNO software** serves you either way.
For: New brands, sub-brands and the enablers that host them

An **MVNE** (mobile virtual network enabler) provides the systems an MVNO needs to run: charging, billing, provisioning and often the core network connection to the host operator. One MVNE can host many MVNO brands, each with its own plans and customers.
An MVNO owns the brand and the customer. Behind it, an MVNE runs the technology. The host operator owns the radio network.

items.q: What is the difference between an MVNO and an MVNE?
items.a: An MVNO sells mobile service under its own brand. An **MVNE** provides the platform that MVNOs run on, including charging, billing and provisioning.

items.q: What does an MVNO platform include?
items.a: An **MVNO platform** covers self-care, CRM, billing, real-time charging and sales channels. You get these together as BSS in a Box.

items.q: Can one MVNE host several brands on Alepo?
items.a: Yes. Each brand runs on its own deployment, and settlement handles each brand separately.
